name: Hydrat Queen
biography: Rattus hydra. A many-headed rat-hydra that inflates its neck pouch into a toxic balloon — hovering, shrugging off blows, and blasting foes away with pressurised wind until someone punctures it. Habitat: Forest & Hill.

features.name: Inflated
features.description: While the hydrat's neck pouch is inflated, it can hover, and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, and Slashing damage. If the hydrat takes 20+ Piercing damage on a single turn while inflated, it deflates with a burst of toxic gas and falls Prone. Saving Throw: DC 16 Constitution, each creature within 15 feet of the hydrat when it deflates. Failure: 18 (4d8) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

features.name: Multiple Heads
features.description: The hydrat has 1d6 + 2 heads. Whenever the hydrat takes 20+ damage on a single turn, one of its heads becomes Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The hydrat makes as many Wind Blast attacks as it has heads that aren't Incapacitated.

features.name: Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Wind Blast
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8, range 45 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the hydrat. If the hydrat is inflated, the target takes 4 (1d8) Poison damage.
